## par-p04-v04 — argument map

Shining: the unmade-I Lord throbs and shines by the Lady's power in śiva-to-earth world-form. Doership + aliveness: this itself His world-making and its non-inertness. Objection 1 (effecthood, bheda/abheda) → reply: effecthood just is shining-dependence (etadadhīnaprakāśatva); difference displayed, never real. Usage argument: were the known different, unshining would unmake shining — nothing would be. Objection 2 (veiling by likeness) → reply: the veil destroys itself; never veiled; life-breath cannot throttle.

### Open

- Veil self-destruction asserted as self-evident (pratyuta).
